sources.title: README.md
sources.locator: Intro; One window; Process-isolated; Build from source; License
sources.finding: Tauri 2 desktop app running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and other CLI agents in parallel git worktrees with a shared local code graph (Token Intelligence), live status, history, diff and PR, Hephaestus per-agent process isolation on Windows/macOS/Linux, agents permissionless by default with toggles in Settings > Security; Apache-2.0.

sources.title: LICENSE
sources.finding: Apache License, Version 2.0 for the repository; apps/mobile carries an MIT license file.

sources.title: ROADMAP.md
sources.locator: Foundation shipped; Now building; On the roadmap; Cloud and team layer
sources.finding: Shipped: Threads canvas, Token Intelligence, Database Branches, Tempest Bridge; building: Threads polish, Hephaestus hardening, Automations (beta), more agents, desktop notifications; planned: Tasks tab, mobile apps, remote agents, multi-agent coordination, optional hosted team layer with SSO and audit logs.

sources.title: SECURITY.md
sources.finding: Vulnerability reporting by email with 3 business day acknowledgement.

sources.title: docs/architecture.mdx
sources.finding: Tauri Rust backend manages PTY sessions, git worktrees and an Atlas Node MCP server; React frontend with xterm.js, CodeMirror and diff viewer.

sources.title: docs/agents/supported.mdx
sources.locator: Comparison Table; Provider presets; Manifest-Driven Agents
sources.finding: Agent manifests for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Codex CLI, Antigravity, Opencode, Copilot CLI, Cline, Cursor Agent, Goose, Qwen Code, Droid, Amp, Hermes, Pi, fx, Grok with resume and auto-approve flags per agent.

sources.title: docs/agents/overview.mdx
sources.locator: What Is an Agent Session; Command Construction
sources.finding: An agent session is a PTY in a worktree or project root with a conversation ID resumed across restarts.

sources.title: docs/chat/overview.mdx
sources.locator: Three backends; Model picker; CLI agent bridges
sources.finding: Chat nodes run API (BYOK via OS credential manager), CLI agent or Warp backends; CLI bridges use the CLI's own login.

sources.title: docs/workspaces/overview.mdx
sources.finding: A workspace is a git worktree under .tempest/<name> with its own branch; shared dependencies symlinked.

sources.title: docs/git/worktrees.mdx
sources.finding: create_terminal_worktree flow including initial commit when the repo is empty.

sources.title: docs/git/push-pr.mdx
sources.finding: Auto-commit and push, push current branch and PR creation from the diff.

sources.title: docs/tasks/overview.mdx
sources.finding: Tasks tab is an inbox of GitHub issues, PRs and Linear issues via the gh CLI; Launch agent into a fresh worktree.

sources.title: docs/automations/overview.mdx
sources.locator: What an automation is; schedule picker
sources.finding: Automations (beta) run scheduled headless agent runs with RRULE schedules, agent, model and scope.

sources.title: docs/token-intelligence/overview.mdx
sources.locator: What is Atlas; How Indexing Works
sources.finding: Atlas builds a local code knowledge graph in .atlas/atlas.db and exposes it over MCP; no cloud processing.

sources.title: docs/token-intelligence/mcp.mdx
sources.finding: Atlas MCP server in direct, daemon and proxy modes serving concurrent agents.

sources.title: docs/knowledge-base/overview.mdx
sources.finding: Knowledge Base tab shows the Atlas graph and a docs library.

sources.title: docs/installation.mdx
sources.finding: Windows 10 1809+, macOS 11+, Linux system requirements; pre-built installers.

sources.title: apps/mobile/README.md
sources.locator: Transport; Testing the pair flow; Not in this release
sources.finding: Expo companion over a LAN WebSocket pairing via QR, tunnel optional; no push notifications in this release; iOS builds require the developer's Apple account.

sources.title: apps/relay/README.md
sources.finding: The Cloudflare relay Worker is not used by the current desktop app.

sources.title: src/lib/telemetry.ts
sources.finding: PostHog analytics are off by default (telemetryEnabled false), loaded only after the user opts in under Settings > Security, with a random install ID.

sources.title: src/components/SettingsPanel/SecuritySection.tsx
sources.finding: Settings > Security has the opt-in anonymous usage data toggle.

sources.title: src-tauri/crates/hephaestus
sources.finding: Hephaestus crate implements Windows Job Objects, macOS Seatbelt and Linux bubblewrap isolation for agent processes.

sources.title: src-tauri/crates/dbiso
sources.finding: Database isolation crate for per-agent database clones.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/agent_hooks.rs
sources.finding: Loopback receiver for agent lifecycle hooks (turn boundaries, tool calls, permission prompts) authenticated with a per-run token.

sources.title: src-tauri/src/automations.rs
sources.finding: Automation records with project, agent and schedule.

sources.title: src-tauri
sources.locator: bounded search at v0.1.25 of src/, src-tauri/ and docs/: saml, oidc, scim, rbac, roles, spend limit, max-budget, rollback, webhook
sources.finding: Bounded search found no SSO or role model, no spend-cap setting, no webhook trigger and no rollback feature in shipped code.
